# TravelBeez

> TravelBeez (travelbeez.gr) is a Greek-licensed online travel agency operated by FerryBee Travel IKE, based in Kos, Greece. We sell ferry tickets between the Greek islands and the Turkish coast, plus car rental, airport & VIP transfers, travel insurance, Schengen visa consultancy, and luggage services. Site is available in English (/en), Turkish (/tr), and Greek (/el).

## Ferry tickets
- [Ferry booking (EN)](https://travelbeez.gr/en/ferry): Search and book ferry tickets between Greek islands and Turkey.
- [Feribot bileti (TR)](https://travelbeez.gr/tr/ferry): Yunan adaları ve Türkiye arası feribot bileti arama ve satın alma.
- [Ακτοπλοϊκά εισιτήρια (EL)](https://travelbeez.gr/el/ferry): Αναζήτηση και κράτηση ακτοπλοϊκών εισιτηρίων.

## Car rental
- [Car rental (EN)](https://travelbeez.gr/en/car-rental): Rent a car in Kos and the surrounding region.
- [Araç kiralama (TR)](https://travelbeez.gr/tr/car-rental): Kos ve çevresinde araç kiralama.
- [Ενοικίαση αυτοκινήτου (EL)](https://travelbeez.gr/el/car-rental)

## Transfers
- [Airport & VIP transfer (EN)](https://travelbeez.gr/en/transfer): Bodrum airport and VIP transfer service.
- [Havalimanı & VIP transfer (TR)](https://travelbeez.gr/tr/transfer): Bodrum havalimanı ve VIP transfer hizmeti.
- [Μεταφορές (EL)](https://travelbeez.gr/el/transfer)
